title: 12 Marketing Automation Tools for Small Businesses

facts.fact: CoSchedule's The State of AI in Marketing 2025 report found that 83% of 1000+ surveyed marketing professionals are seeing increased productivity since adopting AI into their marketing workflows.
facts.quote: reveals that an astounding 83% of 1000+ surveyed marketing professionals are seeing increased productivity since adopting AI into their marketing workflows.

facts.fact: RingCentral RingEX pricing packages start from $20, with prices depending on business size (number of marketing team members) and required features.
facts.quote: Prices depend on the size of your business (number of marketing team members) and the features you require, and start from $20.

facts.fact: Mailchimp is used by over 13 million businesses, according to the page.
facts.quote: Mailchimp is a leading email marketing tool used by over 13 million businesses to create and send engaging and personalized emails.

facts.fact: The article was published on December 28, 2021.
Mailchimp's paid plans for email marketing and automation start at $7 per month, according to the article.
facts.quote: SMBs will need to invest in the paid plans for email marketing and automation, which start at $7 per month.

facts.fact: StoreYa Traffic Booster paid plans start at $120 for the first month, and its pricing includes the total advertising budget with no additional fees.
facts.quote: Traffic Booster pricing includes your total advertising budget with no additional fees. Paid plans start at $120 for the first month

facts.fact: Wishpond packages start at $49 per month, with tailored pricing available for specific business needs.
facts.quote: Wishpond packages start at $49 per month, with tailored pricing available to match specific business needs.

facts.quote: One-time purchase starts at $80 per 100 words, and by word credits starts at $1080 for 1500 words

facts.fact: Zapier paid plans start at $19.99 per month, and Zapier offers three packages including a free option.
facts.quote: Zapier offers three packages, including a free option for businesses requiring fewer features. Paid plans start at $19.99 per month.

facts.fact: According to the article, Zapier lets businesses automate work across more than 9,000 apps.
facts.quote: By empowering SMBs to automate work across 9,000+ apps—including RingCentral, Salesforce, and leading e-commerce tools

facts.fact: Adobe Marketo Engage offers four plans (Growth, Select, Prime, and Ultimate), and the article says current pricing must be requested from its sales team.
facts.quote: Adobe Marketo Engage offers four different plans—Growth, Select, Prime, and Ultimate—and choosing between them will depend on your marketing automation needs and business budget.

facts.fact: Botnation AI offers a free plan with no time limit for SMBs to build and test their chatbot before going live.
facts.quote: Botnation AI offers a free plan with no time limit to allow SMBs to build and test their chatbot before going live.

facts.fact: Botnation AI paid plans start at $39, depending on channels, features, and level of support required.
facts.quote: Paid plans are also available for publishing and scaling, with pricing starting at $39—this is dependent on the channels, features, and level of support required.

facts.fact: Botnation AI's own materials claim its automated customer support resolves up to 80% of requests without agent involvement.
facts.quote: Automated customer support that resolves up to 80% of requests without agent involvement

facts.fact: Botnation AI's chatbot builder is claimed to be deployable in under 10 minutes.
facts.quote: No-code drag-and-drop chatbot builder deployable in under 10 minutes

facts.fact: HubSpot Marketing Hub has four plans, with a free plan and paid plans starting at $15.
facts.quote: HubSpot Marketing Hub has four plans. The free plan includes email campaign automation, lead capture form creation, and live chat setup, while paid plans—starting at $15—offer more capabilities

facts.fact: Integrately offers a free option covering only 100 tasks, and paid packages starting at $19.99.
facts.quote: Integrately offers a free option that covers only 100 tasks and four package options—Starter, Professional Growth, and Business—at a very affordable price, starting at $19.99.

facts.fact: Integrately's free option covers only 100 tasks.
facts.quote: Integrately offers a free option that covers only 100 tasks

facts.fact: Integrately states it connects with over 1500 popular apps.
facts.quote: connect and integrate with over 1500 popular apps, including RingCentral, several CRMs, email marketing platforms, and social media tools.

facts.fact: Planable is free for the first 50 posts with no time limit; paid plans start at $33 per month.
facts.quote: Users can use Planable for free for the first 50 posts—no time limit. Paid plans, on the other hand, start at $33 per month.

facts.fact: The page defines marketing automation as the use of software to automatically execute, manage, and optimize repetitive marketing tasks without requiring manual effort for each action.
facts.quote: Marketing automation is the use of software to automatically execute, manage, and optimize repetitive marketing tasks without requiring manual effort for each action.

facts.fact: The page lists email follow-up sequences, lead scoring, social media publishing, paid ad bid management, CRM data entry, customer segmentation, SMS workflows, and campaign reporting as examples of repetitive, rule-based marketing tasks that can be automated.
facts.quote: Most repetitive, rule-based marketing tasks can be automated, including email follow-up sequences, lead scoring, social media publishing, paid ad bid management, CRM data entry, customer segmentation, SMS workflows, and campaign reporting.

facts.fact: The page recommends that small businesses start with one or two automation tools that integrate with existing tools and set clear success metrics before going live.
facts.quote: choose one or two automation tools that integrate with what you already have, set clear success metrics before you go live, and expand deliberately once you have results to guide your next decision.
